v0.1.0.description: Initial prototype release. Expect problems, mainly releasing to find any crashes
v0.1.0.title: v.0.1.0 - Initial prototype release

v0.1.1.description:
Added an unlockable gate to the mountaintop area. This was already implemented in the apworld but not in-game. 

Known issues: Hole 1 bounties logic not working correctly (is intended to only be 'in logic' if both regions 'Hole 1' and 'Front Yard' are accessible
Sometimes the APWorld thinks the shop items behind the counter are accessible when they're not.
v0.1.1.title: v0.1.1 - Mountaintop gate

v0.1.2.description:
Stray cash lying around the course are now locations
Added filler items "Music pitch up" and "Music pitch down", which just changes the pitch of the radio & pro shop music.
Added various trap items. These are:
- Traps to lower the friction of the green or fairway
- Traps to increase the bounciness of the green or fairway
- Trap to cause the fairway to continuously add velocity to the ball
- Evil kookaburra trap

The traps that affect the golf ball physics should only last 60 seconds.
v0.1.2.title: Stray cash and traps

v0.1.3.description:
Major Changes:

Added breakable objects as checks. These include: 

- Three carpark signs
- Two meetup signs (2 checks each)
- Ply-board inside upstairs cash room
- 'Under Construction' holes 10-18 sign.

Added golf holes as checks. These include:
- Holes 1-9
- Every putt putt hole excluding ones that only exist in bounties
- Three 'No Cheese Chip' holes

Added the various rooms in the Pro Shop upstairs floors as locations
Added collecting the cash in the Pro Shop upstairs as locations
Added the lost golf ball as a location
Added the button inside Luke's office as a location

Hopefully fixed the cause of world generation errors by adding safeguards so the random region+club+difficulties won't create an unwinnable start
v0.1.3.title: Breakable Signs & GolfHoles

v0.1.31.description:
- Added unlocking the practice swing panel as an item
- Added teleporter panels #1 and #2 as items
- Fixed reconnecting causing the player to join with 0 cash
- Fixed reconnecting causing the player to lose their clubs
v0.1.31.title: Small items & small fixes

v0.1.32.description:
- Added items for unlocking the rangefinder and the crouching grid vision
- Added fillers item to slightly increase player movespeed, and set music pitch back to normal
- Fixed the game not letting the archipelago server know when the goal has been completed
- Save location now uses the RoomSeed in its foldername (AppData\LocalLow\Luke Muscat\Normal Golf Game\AP_###)
- Disabled the events that start after completing the 'My First Multi Hit' and 'Cross County' bounties.
- Cached the item names at shop/collectable locations on game initialization to prevent stutters when looking at the locations
- Fixed various issues with collectables respawning on reconnect and cash being rewarded on reconnect
- Fixed the cash register stray cash being in the wrong location in the apworld
- Fixed the cash register and boxes stray cash having their IDs swapped
- Fixed audio-based filler items not being altered ingame.
v0.1.32.title: A few new items & more bugfixes

v0.1.32hotfix.description:
Hopefully fixed issues with saving & loading & reading the JSON save files

-Fixed the Hole 6 gate gameobject path being incorrect
v0.1.32hotfix.title: Save file hotfix
